_comment: ONE source of truth for what motion this engine can perform. mocap_retarget.py reads it for action->clip candidates and its per-action window; bake.py derives the per-character clip set from it. Adding an action is a data edit here plus the .bvh next door. See ATTRIBUTION.md for the licence (CMU motion is commercial-safe to retarget and ship, and NOT to resell as data).
_window: Fraction of the source trial that actually holds the motion, MEASURED with tools/bvhwindow.py, never guessed. The retargeter samples lo + (i*step) % window with step = 120/fps = 5, so a one-shot wants window_frames ~= frames*5 (it then walks the slice once instead of wrapping), while a cycle can use any window it likes.
_verified: false means the clip is measured and wired but no bake has been LOOKED at yet, so it stays out of the default character clip set. Shipping motion nobody has watched is how a jump ends up sampling its own landing.

fight.note: strike slice of the fight clip -- the swing, not the wind-down

idle.note: 100STYLE Neutral standing take (CC BY 4.0, ../100style/ATTRIBUTION.md), window MEASURED 2026-10-03 with a Blender probe: knees 2 deg, trunk 1 deg across 0.25-0.75, the performer still between walking in and out. 120 frames (5 s) with the first half-second crossfaded from the frames after the slice, so it loops without a pop. The previous source, CMU 140_06, holds a CROUCH (knees 57 deg, trunk bent 33 deg) from 10% of the trial on: the aim retarget hid it by never driving legs or spine, the rotation transfer showed it. 140_06 stays second for the legacy aim path (FS_RETARGET=aim), which only knows CMU names.

jump.note: root height peaks at 0.295 of the trial (26.04 vs a 17.5 standing baseline) so 0.18-0.44 holds take-off, apex and landing. WATCHED 2026-09-04 and REJECTED: mid-clip reads as standing — no tuck, no extension, limbs barely differ from idle. The vertical is stripped by INPLACE (correct — the controller supplies the arc) but the limb motion in this trial is too subtle to read as a jump without it. Needs a tighter window around the apex, or a more athletic trial.

sneak.note: Walk Crouched, steady energy. WATCHED 2026-09-04: genuinely crouched — hips-to-head measures 0.481 against 0.645 standing, so it is leaning, not just walking slowly. The heist kit's sneak had no animation at all.

swim.note: swim mode has no swim clip; energy steady from 0.25 on. Not baked yet — unwatched, so it does not ship.

die.note: root height 20.5 -> 31.6 -> 6.0 across 0.48-0.72, ends grounded. WATCHED 2026-09-04: the body IS collapsed face-down and sprawled, which is already far better than death-by-rotating-the-mesh-90-degrees. Held back because INPLACE strips the fall, so the corpse lies horizontally at hip height instead of on the floor. Needs the controller to drop the body, or root Y kept for this action.
